description: Range elements are filtering syntax used after the 'range' keyword in FLAC commands. They select subsets of model objects based on geometric regions, attributes, or logical conditions.

examples: structure node fix velocity range cylinder end-1 0 0 0 end-2 0 0 10 radius 5
notes: Multiple range elements create intersection (AND) by default
Unspecified range affects all objects of target type

A token the range parser does not know ends the range phrase instead of failing it: on FLAC3D 9.8.54 'zone group ... range position-x 0 1 nosuch' assigned the group to the 4 zones selected so far and only then reported 'Unused extra parameter (nosuch)'. Check spelling before trusting a silent range.

live_enumeration_flac3d_97.description: Full range-element keyword set enumerated live from FLAC3D 9.7 ('<cmd> range <bogus>' error enumeration, 2026-08-13). All 22 elements documented above are present. The unified 9.x kernel enumerates elements from ALL engines -- acceptance does not imply the element selects anything meaningful for FLAC data (same caveat as plot-items).
notes: dfn/fid/fidlist/fracture-id may still be FLAC-relevant when the DFN module is used; they are grouped by primary origin (DFN/3DEC/PFC), not by hard rejection.
Evidence grade: syntax (enumeration only); per-element parameter shapes of the undocumented elements are not yet curated.

live_enumeration_flac2d_9.description: Range-element set enumerated live from FLAC2D 9 (2026-08-13): 46 elements.
notes: 'circle' replaces 'sphere' as the 2D radial region ('radius' is its parameter-style companion).
All 22 elements documented above are present in the 2D enumeration except sphere and cylinder.

live_enumeration_flac3d_98.description: Range-element keyword set listed by 'zone group ... range ?' and 'zone hide range ?' on FLAC3D 9.8.54 (2026-10-31): 68 tokens. Same vocabulary as 9.7 plus 'radius' (a 2D parameter that selects nothing in 3D) and minus 'undo'. Every element referenced by this index is in it; the 3DEC / PFC / MassFlow-specific tokens are accepted by the parser but have no FLAC data behind them.

verified_state.cmodel: 4 of 8 zones with 'elastic' on a half-elastic / half-mohr-coulomb brick
verified_state.velocity: 'velocity 0.5 1.5' on gridpoints -> the 18 gridpoints initialised to 1.0
verified_state.orientation: 'dip 0 surface' -> the 4 top faces only; bottom needs 'normal 0 0 -1'
verified_state.seed: 'uniform' -> all 24 surface faces; criterion keyword is required
verified_state.use-hidden: 8 zones with half hidden, 4 without it
